scope: Twelve independent source tasks. These are reconstructed decision-only scenarios with simplified simulated repository facts, not exact historical re-executions or a representative frequency sample. Holdouts are withheld from this instruction edit, not unseen historical tasks.
review: Primary-assistant review of complete native reports and action results supplements action assertions; no wording score or model judge. An ACK is not executed validation.
stoppingRule: Run twelve scenarios once each for Astra and Fable. Classify errors and failures. At most one targeted correction/retry for a demonstrated batch defect; do not expand cases. Passing deterministic checks and accepted current-skill behavior conclude this batch.
liveBoundary: No live helpers or provider adapters change. No new GitHub smoke is needed for this prose-only batch; existing live evidence remains qualified by its original snapshot.
